test_title: PYST 26: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

WORD - WDRO - DROW

OATS - OSTA - STAO
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79f4ce84f41ca0e0d712dd94bd797b740ceb59ec5aeab4d6634a9ff1e68e7f37.png] 

The Logic followed here is:

WORD - WDRO - DROW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a750c914f6fdae5a1a91799ca5ea0360cc3cac80c24cd8f46b45ec9b1240b82f.png] 

And,

OATS - OSTA - STAO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f803735e1437e84560bff42e52e2049f78dca2efb0c5c50ffb1c74fdb779098.png] 

Similarly,

GIVE - GEVI - EVIG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d11078893f45514a1c13e435deba6395d8c1e878578092520f4a1f0cd42986f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
